statement: Within the searched and retrieved literature, no directly matching work was found that provides a benchmark of amended statutes/regulations with near-duplicate successive revisions and time-stamped queries: the closest temporal benchmarks found are ESG disclosures (TemporalESG), point-in-time SEC filings (TempFinQA), and date-annotated web QA (SituatedQA/TimeQA), while retrieved regulatory-document work is static. This is an absence-of-evidence finding from the searched set (arXiv, OpenAlex, Crossref queries, and citation metadata), not proof that no such benchmark exists.

evidence.quote: TemporalESG comprises 40,814 ESG disclosure documents across Vietnamese, English, and Arabic from 43 multinational corporations spanning 11 years (2015-2025), with 970 validated temporal queries.
we further introduce TempFinQA, a point-in-time evaluation protocol built from public filings and XBRL facts
most are focused on static question answering and do not address the temporal dynamics of legal knowledge
